title: Wounded crown nearly ready to demo
author: Old_man_junky
selftext:
Spent a month basically writing up a bible for the game, concept, abilities, units, cards, ideas and stats. 

I've used AI art as I'm not an artist and well £20 for Claude and £12 for pixellabsai is not breaking the bank. 

All my music is either sampled and credited licence free or greater myself with a daw and vst of the BBC orchestra and then hours of messing around seeing what sticks. If it ever did well I'd probably hire an artist to go back and redo the work but like most things it will probably remain a passion project that never makes the store 🥲

Vigorously promoted and refined based on my own QA creating with Claude and Godot. 

It's basically a love letter to games like final fantasy tactics but based around chess, with elements of slay the spire, balatro and Pokémon. 

I'm hoping to have a demo out within the next week.

comments.author: Chacudno
comments.body:
My friend, it is not ready. Please hold off.

I suggest running every still image you have through Gemini and tell it to get rid of the pixel look.  Pixels generally are fine but you have THE chatgpt standard pixel look and its fkn terrible. Everyone hates it. Stevie Wonder would say "this looks like shit."

Once you fix the images and hopefully find an art direction fitting. 
Then you have to look at the wording on your trailer, it's a LOT of nothing just generic "Will you fall or climb" "will you kill or be killed" "can you up instead of down?"

It's supposed to be inspiring I guess but as a player nothing about that trailer told me WHAT or WHY I'm doing. Am I a hero? Am I going from peasent to king? Am I a soldier? Is this an RTS or a battle sim? Or a merge game?

You have the bones of something here but you're not there yet. If you release a demo you're going to get crushed.

replies.author: Old_man_junky
replies.body:
I appreciate you taking the time you give me an honest critique. It's more valuable to be told it looks shit by a stranger than to be told it looks good by a friend. 

I agree there's a lot of muddiness that needs refining. The art work is very basic prototyping, I've been hand scoring the music for the past few days and playtesting and re-writing cards and abilities, the trailer should probably showcase more of the unique merge mechanics. 

As for the flavour text, yeah I agree it's very generic. I was going for simple, but if it's too simple I will take it on board. 

I just didn't want to overcomplicate what is essentially TRPG roguelite based on chess, the oldest strategy of all time 😅

Thank you ❤️
